section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 每个博彩细分领域具有独特的金融犯罪风险
en_quote: This means that the financial crime risk associated with each gaming segment is unique.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 赌场和在线运营商均易遭受多种洗钱方式，如筹码转换和伪造文件开户
en_quote: For example, both casinos and online operators are vulnerable to many forms of money laundering, such as customers converting illicit funds into chips, engaging in minimal play, and using falsified documents to open multiple accounts.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 博彩业具有固有高金融犯罪风险的独特特征
en_quote: The gaming sector has unique characteristics that carry inherently high financial crime risks.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 博彩业风险因素包括监管环境碎片化、跨境活动和准金融服务
en_quote: These include risks associated with a fragmented regulatory environment, the cross-border nature of activities, and the offering of quasi-financial services.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 交易种类、频率和数量带来的固有风险
en_quote: Another inherent risk arises from the variety, frequency, and volume of transactions.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 在线游戏增长带来非面对面交互和新兴技术漏洞
en_quote: This situation is further complicated by the rapid growth of online gaming, which involves non-face-to-face customer interactions and onboarding, along with emerging technologies that often introduce vulnerabilities alongside opportunity.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 远程开户使在线博彩运营商面临高风险司法管辖区敞口
en_quote: Since online gaming operators onboard customers remotely, they might face exposure to high-risk jurisdictions.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 快速开户流程吸引犯罪分子，缺乏控制时身份欺诈风险上升
en_quote: The quick onboarding process appeals to criminals, and the risk of identity fraud escalates when necessary controls are lacking.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 在线博彩运营商可能因IP欺骗或地理定位失败而允许辖区外客户参与
en_quote: Additionally, online gaming operators might inadvertently permit customers outside the jurisdiction to participate in gaming if IP spoofing occurs or geolocation safeguards fail, usually facilitated by users accessing the website or mobile application through a VPN.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 实体赌场面临金融犯罪风险
en_quote: Physical casinos encounter certain financial crime risks as well.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 赌场虽非金融机构但提供准金融服务
en_quote: While they are not classified as financial institutions, they do provide quasi-financial services.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 赌场提供的准金融服务包括资金托管、货币兑换、转账、储值、支票兑现和保险箱
en_quote: For example, they accept funds on account, perform money and foreign currency exchanges, facilitate money transfers, provide stored-value services, cash checks, and offer safe deposit boxes.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 赌场因提供准金融服务而面临与金融机构类似的风险
en_quote: These services potentially expose them to many of the same risks faced by financial institutions.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 赌团因跨境资金和人员流动及涉及高净值人士而具有高风险
en_quote: Junkets, a form of tourism, including sponsored or incentive-based trips, are also inherently high-risk due to the cross-border movement of funds and people, particularly involving high-net-worth individuals.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 赌团运营商不收集了解你的客户信息导致客户身份和资金来源透明度风险
en_quote: Junket operators refer clients to casinos and seldom collect KYC details from the customers and share them with casinos. This practice introduces risks regarding transparency of customer identification and source of funds.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 实体和在线博彩均易受金融犯罪风险影响
en_quote: Both physical and online gaming are susceptible to certain financial crime risks.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 博彩业面临有组织犯罪、高利贷、卖淫、毒品和人口贩卖等上游犯罪威胁
en_quote: They encounter criminal threats such as organized crime, loan sharking, prostitution, drug dealing, and human trafficking, all of which are predicate offenses.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 博彩业存在通过第三方和多笔交易规避报告门槛的结构化交易风险
en_quote: They are also at risk of transaction structuring to evade reporting thresholds, including the use of third parties and multiple transactions to arrange deposits.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Gaming sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 在P2P或串通博彩中参与者可能故意输牌以转移价值
en_quote: In peer-to-peer or collusion gaming, such as poker, participants might intentionally lose to another player to transfer value and potentially criminal proceeds.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 房地产行业因交易金额大和资产有形性而固有洗钱风险
en_quote: The real estate sector is inherently susceptible to money laundering due to the substantial sums involved in property transactions and the tangible nature of these assets.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 犯罪分子通过购买高价值房地产将非法资金融入合法经济
en_quote: Criminals can utilize real estate to integrate illicit funds into the legitimate economy by purchasing tangible assets, typically of significant value.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 出售房地产时通过完整的文件记录使非法收益合法化
en_quote: The gains or profits are realized upon the sale of the asset, which, by then, is fully supported and legitimized in the paper trail of sale documentation, allowing money launderers to benefit from it.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 房地产交易中律师等第三方的参与进一步使资金流动合法化
en_quote: Real estate transactions often involve lawyers and other third parties, further legitimizing the movement of funds.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 买卖或租赁房地产为犯罪分子通过模糊所有权结构掩饰资金来源提供机会
en_quote: Buying, selling, or renting properties presents opportunities for criminals to disguise the origin of funds through obscured ownership structures.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 由公司、信托或代名人购买房产且无合理解释是红旗信号信号
en_quote: For example, properties acquired by corporate entities, trusts, or nominees without a clear justification as to why they were not purchased directly by an individual are red flags.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 购买实体业务活动极少且无合理解释进一步引起担忧
en_quote: The lack of justification raises further concerns if the entity has minimal business activity.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 实体位于公司保密司法管辖区（如开曼群岛或巴哈马）也是风险信号
en_quote: It is also a concern if the entity is based in a jurisdiction known for its corporate secrecy for example, the Cayman Islands or the Bahamas.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 房地产市场的全球性使检测工作更加复杂
en_quote: The global nature of the real estate market further complicates detection efforts. International buyers and cross-border transactions can mask illicit activities.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs
knowledge_zh: 来自高风险或未合作司法管辖区的买家构成额外洗钱风险
en_quote: A buyer from a high-risk or uncooperative jurisdiction, one lacking an established local presence or legitimate reason for purchasing property, poses an additional risk.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks

en_quote: Their involvement in handling financial records provides easy access to data, and their inability to detect suspicious activity might lead them to unwittingly create complex structures that enable illegal activities, such as structuring.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks

en_quote: Tax avoidance involves legally minimizing tax liabilities, while tax evasion includes illegal actions, such as falsifying records or concealing income.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Real estate sector risks
heading_context: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs

en_quote: For secretaries, heightened money laundering risks arise if they fail to vet key stakeholders or identify red flags in corporate structures and transactions.

knowledge_zh: 缺乏尽职调查维护公司记录或支持公司治理流程，可能使犯罪分子掩盖最终受益所有人身份。
en_quote: A lack of due diligence in maintaining company records or supporting corporate governance processes could enable criminals to obscure UBO identities, unwittingly facilitating illicit activities.

en_quote: These nominee directors or shareholders can be used to conceal the identity of the UBO or operator of the business, creating a layer of anonymity that heightens money laundering risks through obfuscation.

section_title: Money laundering risks associated with DNFBPs > Trust and company service provider and company secretary sector risks

en_quote: Criminals might use this nominee structure to distance themselves from illicit activities and treat it as a cover to move funds across jurisdictions with weak regulations.

en_quote: Shelf companies are often sold to customers looking to bypass procedural requirements or expedite company formation.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > High-value asset risks

en_quote: The use of complex ownership structures: These include the use of shell companies. These can obscure the true beneficial owner of the asset, which makes it difficult to trace the source of funds.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > High-value asset risks

en_quote: Transactions between high-risk jurisdictions or jurisdictions known for money laundering: These jurisdictions provide favorable environments for criminals to carry out money laundering schemes.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > High-value asset risks

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Case example: Suspicious transactions at Goodwish Jade
heading_context: Case example: Suspicious transactions at Goodwish Jade

en_quote: Upon examining the KYC documents, the officer found that GJ is owned by an offshore company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands, a high-risk jurisdiction for tax secrecy and lax beneficial ownership registers.

en_quote: Businesses with diversified operations, particularly in high-value and risky sectors, should be subject to enhanced due diligence to evaluate their activities and risks.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 贸易洗钱的定义及犯罪分子利用进出口业务实施金融犯罪的方法概述。
en_quote: Trade-based money laundering is a process through which criminals disguise the proceeds of crime and transfer value by using trade transactions to legitimize their illicit origins. Criminals frequently exploit import and export businesses to facilitate financial crime and employ a variety of methods to do so, including:

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 低开发票：以低于公平市场价的价格开具发票，卖方借此向买方转移价值。
en_quote: Under-invoicing: This describes invoicing goods or services at a price below the fair market value. The seller can transfer value to the buyer by presenting an invoice that reflects a lower price than what is charged in the market.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 高开发票：以高于公平市场价的价格销售，卖方获得超出货物实际价值的付款。
en_quote: Over-invoicing: In contrast to under-invoicing, goods or services are sold at a price above the fair market value. This allows the seller to receive more from the buyer than the actual worth of the goods or services.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 多重发票：对同一批货物开具多张发票，为多次付款提供依据。
en_quote: Multiple invoicing: This method involves issuing multiple invoices for the same shipment of goods, enabling the criminal to justify numerous payments based on these invoices.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 短装：实际发货数量少于发票数量，卖方从超额付款中获利。
en_quote: Short-shipping: This occurs when the actual quantity of goods shipped is less than the quantity of goods invoiced. The seller can benefit financially from the excess payment made.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 超装：实际发货数量多于发票数量，买方从超额付款中获利。
en_quote: Over-shipping: This occurs when the actual quantity shipped is more than the quantity of goods invoiced. The buyer can benefit financially from the excess payment made.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 幽灵运输：虚构贸易，无真实货物对应的运输单据。
en_quote: Ghost-shipping: This describes fictitious trades where either no buyer or seller exists, or collusion occurs to create shipping documents that do not correspond to any actual goods being shipped.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 信用证欺诈：滥用信用证操纵进出口价格或为不存在的货物付款。
en_quote: Letters of credit (L/C) fraud: L/C can be misused to transfer money between buyers and sellers by manipulating import and export prices or facilitating payments for nonexistent goods.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 两用物品贸易带来独特的洗钱风险。
en_quote: The trade of dual-use goods poses unique risks of money laundering.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 犯罪分子可能利用两用物品规避制裁并清洗非法所得。
en_quote: Criminals might attempt to evade sanctions by using these goods to facilitate illicit trade and disguise transactions from authorities. The proceeds from these activities would then need to be laundered.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 进出口行业因交易跨多个司法管辖区，资金来源风险尤为突出。
en_quote: The source of funds risk affects all businesses; however, the import/export sectors are particularly vulnerable as transactions often span multiple jurisdictions.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Key takeaways
knowledge_zh: 犯罪分子利用全球反洗钱监管差异，选择薄弱司法管辖区进行贸易洗钱。
en_quote: Due to the differing applications of AML regulations globally, criminals might strategically structure their trade activities to exploit jurisdictions with weak, ineffective, or inadequate AML regulations where the source of funds is the point of entry to the financial system via import/export businesses.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区（FTZ）是境内关外的指定区域，货物入区免关税。
en_quote: A free-trade zone (FTZ) is a designated area within a country treated as outside its customs territory, allowing businesses to import, store, handle, manufacture, and distribute goods without incurring customs duties until those goods enter the domestic market.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区最初旨在吸引外资和创造就业，多位于发展中国家。
en_quote: FTZs were originally set up to attract foreign direct investments and create jobs, and they are often located in developing countries.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 截至2025年，全球约130个国家拥有约4500个自由贸易区。
en_quote: According to the think tank Global Financial Integrity, approximately 4,500 FTZs exist in more than 130 countries as of 2025.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区为企业节省成本、改善现金流并提升国际竞争力。
en_quote: FTZs benefit companies by offering cost savings, enhancing cash flow, and boosting their competitiveness in international trade.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区可降低或取消税收、关税及商业注册监管要求。
en_quote: FTZs can lower or remove taxes, customs duties, and business registration regulations.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 许多自由贸易区提供标准移民程序和外资限制的特别豁免。
en_quote: Many zones globally offer special exemptions from standard immigration procedures and foreign investment restrictions, among other benefits.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区旨在促进经济活动和就业
en_quote: These zones aim to promote economic activity and employment that might otherwise take place elsewhere.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区的商业友好特征吸引犯罪分子利用
en_quote: However, their business-friendly features attract criminals to exploit them.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 欧盟指出自由贸易区腐败、逃税、欺诈和制裁规避高发
en_quote: The EU has commented that FTZs have a high incidence of corruption, tax evasion, and other criminal activities, such as fraud and sanctions evasion.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 欧盟委员会指出自由贸易区对贸易体系构成新兴威胁
en_quote: The European Commission has also pointed out that since FTZs are popular for storing artwork, antiquities, precious metals, and wine, and that they pose emerging threats to the integrity of the trade system.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: FATF指出的自由贸易区系统性弱点列表
en_quote: According to FATF, systemic weaknesses for FTZs include:

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区反洗钱/反恐怖融资保障措施不足
en_quote: Inadequate AML/CFT safeguards.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 地方当局对自由贸易区监管极少
en_quote: Minimal oversight by local authorities.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区货物和法人检查程序薄弱，记录保存和IT系统不足
en_quote: Weak procedures to inspect goods and legal entities, including inadequate recordkeeping and information technology systems.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区与当地海关当局缺乏合作
en_quote: Lack of cooperation between FTZs and local customs authorities.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区通过伪造文件进口再出口货物，便利贸易洗钱
en_quote: FTZs might enable TBML by importing consignments with counterfeit or tampered paperwork and then re-exporting the goods to other countries while disguising their actual origin and nature.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区为毒品、象牙、艺术品走私和人口贩运提供平台
en_quote: This environment also provides a platform for illegal trades, such as drug trafficking, ivory trade, stolen artwork, and people smuggling.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 自由贸易区执法不力便利逃税和增值税欺诈
en_quote: Additionally, FTZ regulations with inadequate enforcement might facilitate tax evasion and VAT fraud by allowing criminals to obscure the actual beneficial owners of assets derived from crimes.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Free-trade zones risks
knowledge_zh: 监管宽松阻碍当局追踪和追回犯罪所得
en_quote: This can hinder authorities and law enforcement agencies from tracing and recovering proceeds of crime due to relaxed oversight.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 替代性汇款系统是常用的价值转移方式
en_quote: An alternative remittance system (ARS) is a frequently used method for transferring value.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 替代性汇款系统在全球多种形式存在，信任是核心
en_quote: Globally, this form of money movement has existed in several forms across numerous jurisdictions, with one recurring theme involved in its transfer process: trust.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 替代性汇款系统运营者无货币服务企业牌照
en_quote: Those operating an alternative remittance system do not hold an MSB license or equivalent.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 哈瓦拉是最知名的替代性汇款系统形式
en_quote: The best-known form of ARS is a hawala, an informal system involving the international transfer of value outside the legitimate banking system.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 哈瓦拉基于信任和债务安排等额货币转移，而非实际资金
en_quote: Hawala rely on collaborative parties setting up a transfer and exchange process built on trust, and often debt, to move the value of funds. This is usually done by arranging for equivalent amounts of currency to be transferred at the customer’s instruction, rather than by transferring the actual funds.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 替代性汇款系统源于电汇前物理运输货币的高风险
en_quote: Before wire transfers, ARSs were born of necessity. Physically transporting money carried a high risk of theft and loss. Merchants would meet, agree on the terms of a deal, and then arrange for payment via a trust-based system.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 哈瓦拉经纪人维护合作转账人及其可用资金和货币的分类账
en_quote: Similarly, today, hawala brokers maintain a ledger of collaborative transferors along with their available funds and currencies.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 汇款人向经纪商提供本币资金及费用，经纪商利用海外转账网络完成跨境转移。
en_quote: The “remitter” provides an amount in a local currency plus fees to the broker, who relies on their network of transferors overseas to effectively forward that amount in the local currency.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 转账方可能欠经纪商债务，通过向收款人第三方支付偿还，或作为合作方收取服务费。
en_quote: Those transferors may owe the broker a debt, which they repay to the “remitter’s” payee as a third-party payment, or they may be a collaborative partner who charges the payee a service fee.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 价值跨境转移且货币兑换不涉及银行或货币服务企业（货币服务企业）。
en_quote: As a result, the value is transferred overseas, and the currency is converted without involving a bank or money services business (MSB).

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 哈瓦拉系统在以下群体中流行：
en_quote: Hawalas are popular amongst:

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 边缘化社区（如难民和冲突地区居民）缺乏银行渠道或信任。
en_quote: Marginalized communities, such as refugees and those living in conflict zones, who lack access to, or trust in, banks.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 不希望交易留下数字记录的个人。
en_quote: Individuals who do not want a digital record of their transactions.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Alternative remittance systems
knowledge_zh: 恐怖融资者利用哈瓦拉系统的信任和匿名性向高风险地区或国内恐怖组织转移资金。
en_quote: As a result, terrorist financiers leverage hawalas, relying on the trust and anonymity that an ARS provides to transfer money to high-risk geographies or even “directly” to domestic terrorist groups.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 慈善机构和非政府组织（NGO）在满足社会需求方面发挥不可或缺的作用。
en_quote: Charities and nongovernmental organizations, or NGOs, play an indispensable role in addressing societal needs.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: NGO是与特定司法管辖区政府无直接关联的非营利组织。
en_quote: An NGO is a nonprofit organization that is not directly linked to the governments of specific jurisdictions.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 慈善机构和非政府组织提供多种服务和人道主义职能。
en_quote: Similar to charities, they provide a variety of services and humanitarian functions.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 许多司法管辖区给予慈善机构和非政府组织免税地位，允许捐赠者税前扣除。
en_quote: Many jurisdictions will grant charities and NGOs tax-exempt status, allowing donors to deduct their contributions on their tax returns.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 免税地位鼓励公众向公益事业捐款。
en_quote: This encourages the public to make donations to causes that serve the public good.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 这些组织可能被用于洗钱或违反制裁要求。
en_quote: Unfortunately, these organizations could be used to launder illicit funds or breach sanctions requirements.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 因此需要审查慈善机构和非政府组织以确保其持续合法性。
en_quote: For this reason, charities and NGOs need to be scrutinized to ensure their ongoing legitimacy.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 慈善机构和非政府组织具有以下易被金融犯罪滥用的特征：
en_quote: Charities and NGOs have the following characteristics that make them particularly vulnerable to misuse for financial crime:

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 享有公众信任。
en_quote: Enjoying the public trust

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 通常具有全球存在。
en_quote: Often having a global presence

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 可从未知或未披露来源获取大量资金。
en_quote: Having access to considerable funds from unknown or undisclosed sources

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 现金密集型。
en_quote: Being cash-intensive

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 通常位于或邻近恐怖活动暴露区域。
en_quote: Often being in or near areas exposed to terrorist activity

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 高风险行业通常监管很少或设立障碍少
en_quote: Often being subject to little or no regulation or having few obstacles to their creation

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 恐怖组织利用合法慈善机构和非政府组织资助非法活动
en_quote: Although most charities and NGOs are legitimate, terrorist organizations have used them as vehicles to fund their illicit activities.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 慈善机构（尤其是私人基金会）被用于逃税
en_quote: Charities, in particular those organized as private foundations, have also been used to commit tax evasion.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 虚假慈善机构被用于掩盖贿赂和腐败
en_quote: In addition, those engaged in bribery and corruption might use fake charities to give the illusion that corporate payments are for charitable purposes rather than for bribing government officials.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Charity and NGO risks
knowledge_zh: 研究慈善机构时应查询注册机构、免税状态和税务申报
en_quote: While researching charities and NGOs, be sure to search the relevant registration authorities to confirm their exempt status and their annual tax return filings. Also, consult websites that provide unbiased evaluations of charities and NGOs. It is likely that larger organizations will have a list of approved websites to conduct this research.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事组织交易和军事商品服务带来特定金融犯罪风险
en_quote: Military organizations as parties to a transaction and military goods and services pose specific financial crime risks to organizations.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事组织包括以下类型
en_quote: Military organizations include:

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事组织包括武装部队
en_quote: Armed forces

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 政府所有或控制的军事组织
en_quote: Government-owned or -controlled:

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事研究设施属于高风险实体
en_quote: Military research facilities

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 国防制造商属于高风险实体
en_quote: Defense manufacturers

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 私营部门国防供应商属于高风险实体
en_quote: Private-sector defense suppliers

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事商品和服务是用于国防的物品、服务和技术
en_quote: Military goods and services are articles, services, and technology that jurisdictions use for national defense.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事和两用商品因安全和人权威胁常受禁运和出口管制
en_quote: Because of their potential threat to international security and human rights, these items, along with dual-use goods, are routinely subject to embargoes and export controls.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 两用商品是兼具军事和民用用途的物品
en_quote: Dual-use goods are those with both military and civilian uses.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事商品和服务包括以下类别
en_quote: Military goods and services include:

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事商品包括枪支弹药
en_quote: Firearms and ammunition

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 导弹属于军事商品
en_quote: Missiles

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 坦克属于军事商品
en_quote: Tanks

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 飞机属于军事商品
en_quote: Aircraft

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 生物和化学制剂属于高风险商品
en_quote: Biological and chemical agents

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 核武器属于高风险商品
en_quote: Nuclear weapons

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 国防服务、数据和技术属于高风险商品
en_quote: Defense services, data, and technology

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事相关金融犯罪风险包括贿赂腐败、武器禁运与出口管制规避、恐怖融资及大规模杀伤性武器扩散融资
en_quote: Military-related financial crime risks include bribery and corruption, arms embargo and export control evasion, and financing of terrorism and weapons of mass destruction (WMD).

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事组织因政府控制和政治敏感人物参与而具有更高的贿赂与腐败风险
en_quote: Governments own or control many military organizations. Government officials, who are politically exposed persons (PEP) by definition, often oversee or manage these organizations. Therefore, military organizations pose a higher risk for bribery and corruption.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 武器禁运是一种禁止目标管辖区进出口军事或军民两用物品的国际制裁
en_quote: An arms embargo is a type of international sanction that bans a targeted jurisdiction from importing or exporting military or dual-use goods and services.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 出口管制是出于外交政策和国际安全原因管制关键物品贸易的法律和指南
en_quote: Export controls are laws and guidelines that regulate the trade of critical items for reasons of foreign policy and international security. They apply to specific items, including military goods and services, and require exporters to obtain a license to sell these items.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事物品和服务因利润丰厚及受制裁管辖区国家利益而面临较高的规避武器禁运和出口管制风险
en_quote: Evading arms embargoes and export controls can be profitable to individuals and favorable to the national interests of sanctioned jurisdictions. Therefore, military goods and services pose high risk for evasion of these controls.

section_title: High-risk business sectors > Military organization and goods risks
knowledge_zh: 军事物品贸易存在向恐怖组织提供武器及向国家行为体提供大规模杀伤性武器扩散材料的风险
en_quote: Trade involving military goods and services also poses the risk of supplying terrorist organizations with weapons and state-based actors with materials that promote the development and proliferation of WMDs.

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 外国大使馆、领事馆和使团在东道国普遍存在
en_quote: Foreign embassies, foreign consulates, and missions are commonly seen in host countries.

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 大使馆通常位于东道国首都，包含大使办公室、外交代表及工作人员，处理两国政治经济事务
en_quote: An embassy is usually located in the host country's capital city and contains the office of the foreign ambassador, the diplomatic representatives, and their staff. It handles political and economic matters between the two countries, facilitating communication and negotiation.

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 领事馆是大使馆的分支机构，通常位于东道国主要城市，提供签证和移民等行政服务
en_quote: Consulates act as branches of embassies and are typically located in major cities of the host country. They provide various administrative and governmental functions, such as issuing visas and handling immigration matters, similar to what an embassy provides but on a smaller scale.

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 外国使团指在外国从事外交事务以服务本国利益的一群人，包括大使馆和领事馆
en_quote: A foreign mission refers to a group of people that conducts diplomatic business in a foreign country to serve the interests of their home country. A foreign mission can include embassies and consulates.

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 大使馆和使团需要金融服务以满足日常财务责任，包括运营开支和政府间交易
en_quote: These organizations require access to financial services to meet their daily financial responsibilities. Services can range from operational expenses, such as payroll, rent, and utilities, to intergovernmental and intragovernmental transactions, such as commercial and military purchase payments.

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 一些银行还向政府人员（包括使馆工作人员及其家属和前外国官员）提供辅助服务或账户
en_quote: Some banks also offer ancillary services or accounts to government personnel, including embassy staff, their families, and former foreign officials.

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 使馆相关政府关系因涉及政治敏感人物而给银行带来不同程度的风险
en_quote: Each of these governmental relationships poses different levels of risk to the bank because the individuals involved are usually classified as PEPs in most host countries.

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 政治敏感人物指担任显要公职的个人及其直系亲属或密切关联人，可能面临更高的贿赂和腐败风险
en_quote: A PEP is an individual in a prominent political function, or their immediate family or close associates, who could be at higher risk for involvement in bribery and corruption.

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 大使馆、领事馆和使团账户在某些情况下可能构成更高风险
en_quote: Additionally, embassy, foreign consulate, and mission accounts can pose a higher risk in certain circumstances, including:

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 账户位于FATF或其他监管机构认定的洗钱或腐败高风险管辖区
en_quote: Accounts held in jurisdictions designated as higher money laundering or corruption risk by FATF or other regulatory bodies.

section_title: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions
knowledge_zh: 大额现金交易可能表明潜在的非法活动
en_quote: Substantial cash transactions, which might indicate potential illicit activities.

heading_context: Providing financial services to embassies, foreign consulates, and missions

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF于1989年由G7成立，旨在协调打击洗钱
en_quote: The G-7 established the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) in 1989 as an international organization to coordinate efforts to combat money laundering.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF初始成员包括15国和欧盟，现扩展至近40国及区域网络
en_quote: Its original membership included 15 countries and the EU, and it now includes nearly 40 countries as well as a global network of regional groups.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF成立一年内发布40项建议，指导全球反洗钱行动
en_quote: Within a year of its founding, FATF issued its original 40 Recommendations setting forth guidance and a comprehensive action plan for fighting money laundering worldwide.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: 9/11后FATF发布关于恐怖融资的八项特别建议，后增至九项
en_quote: In the wake of the September 11 terrorist attacks in the US, FATF issued eight Special Recommendations on terrorist financing to supplement the original Recommendations. FATF eventually added a ninth Special Recommendation.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF除制定标准外，还通过其他方式开展工作
en_quote: In addition to setting standards through FATF Recommendations, FATF accomplishes its work through:

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF通过定期评估监督各辖区标准实施情况
en_quote: Assessing implementation: FATF conducts periodic formal evaluations and other assessments to determine whether jurisdictions have fully and effectively implemented its standards. If FATF identifies deficiencies, it implements and monitors action plans and publicly reports progress.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF持续监控犯罪和恐怖融资手法与趋势，200多辖区承诺遵守标准
en_quote: Monitoring methods and trends: FATF continuously monitors how criminals and terrorists raise, use, and move funds, and publishes reports to raise awareness of the latest techniques and trends. Over 200 countries and jurisdictions have committed to meeting FATF standards, including many that are not full members of the organization.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF将未达标辖区列入灰名单或黑名单，可能导致金融孤立
en_quote: Identifying high-risk jurisdictions: Where FATF has determined that a jurisdiction has failed to implement its standards, FATF can designate it as a jurisdiction under increased monitoring on the "grey list" or a high-risk jurisdiction on the "black list." FATF designations on the grey and black lists can have severe consequences since inclusion on these lists might lead to isolation from the global financial system.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF式区域机构（FSRB）是协助实施FATF标准的自治区域组织
en_quote: FATF-style regional bodies (FSRB) are autonomous regional organizations that assist in implementing FATF’s standards. These bodies closely align with FATF objectives and have similar forms and functions but operate independently of FATF. FSRBs are also considered FATF associate members.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF依赖FSRB提供意见，但仍是唯一标准制定机构
en_quote: In setting standards, FATF depends on input from the FSRBs. However, FATF remains the only standard-setting body.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FSRB通过识别威胁、促进合作、评估和技术援助确保全球反洗钱/反恐怖融资有效性

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF建议以具有法律约束力的法律或法规形式实施，机构据此遵守
en_quote: FATF intends for their member jurisdictions to implement the Recommendations in the form of legally binding law or regulation, which they can tailor to reflect their respective circumstances and legal structures. As a result, institutions receive the Recommendations as legal and regulatory requirements established within the jurisdictions in which they operate.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF通过定期互评估审查成员国合规情况
en_quote: To assess member jurisdictions’ compliance with the Recommendations, FATF conducts periodic mutual evaluations through formal reviews by AML/CFT authorities from other jurisdictions.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: 互评估报告为公开文件，深入评估成员国合规情况
en_quote: The resulting mutual evaluation reports are public documents that provide an in-depth assessment of a member jurisdiction’s compliance with each Recommendation.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF对每项建议给出技术合规性和有效性评级
en_quote: For each Recommendation, FATF gives a rating for technical compliance and effectiveness.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: FATF要求成员国整改缺陷并接受后续监测
en_quote: FATF then requires member jurisdictions to address any deficiencies and subjects them to post-assessment monitoring to ensure they address their issues.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: 缺陷可能导致成员国被列入灰名单或黑名单
en_quote: Deficiencies can result in a member jurisdiction’s designation on the grey or black lists.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > Financial Action Task Force
knowledge_zh: 灰/黑名单认定导致金融机构在内部风险评估中将其标记为高风险
en_quote: These types of designations are likely to result in financial institutions flagging the member jurisdiction as high risk in their internal risk assessments.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: FATF建议1-8确保成员国建立全面的法律和监管框架以打击洗钱、恐怖融资和扩散融资
en_quote: FATF Recommendations 1 to 8 ensure that member jurisdictions implement comprehensive legal and regulatory frameworks to combat money laundering, terrorist financing, and the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction (WMD). These recommendations fall into three groups.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: FATF建议1和2要求各国评估洗钱和恐怖融资风险并采取风险为本方法
en_quote: Recommendations 1 and 2 advise jurisdictions to assess and understand their money laundering and terrorist financing risks and take a risk-based approach to implementing measures that effectively mitigate these threats.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: 风险为本方法确保应对措施与识别出的风险成比例
en_quote: A riskbased approach ensures that responses are proportionate to the identified risks.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: 各国需建立基于风险评估的反洗钱/反恐怖融资政策并开展国家合作与协调
en_quote: Additionally, national cooperation and coordination are essential, requiring jurisdictions to establish AML/CFT policies informed by risk assessments.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: 各国应指定负责实施反洗钱措施的机关或机制
en_quote: Jurisdictions should also designate an authority or mechanism responsible for implementation.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: 要求建立有效机制促进相关当局之间的协调与合作
en_quote: Effective mechanisms should facilitate coordination and collaboration among relevant authorities.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: FATF建议3和4要求将洗钱定为刑事犯罪并涵盖广泛的上游犯罪
en_quote: Recommendations 3 and 4 advise jurisdictions to criminalize money laundering, ensuring that the offense applies to all serious crimes and encompasses a broad range of predicate offenses.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: 授权主管机关识别、追踪、冻结、扣押和没收犯罪财产及等值资产
en_quote: Additionally, jurisdictions should implement measures that empower competent authorities to identify, trace, freeze, seize, and confiscate criminal property and assets of equivalent value.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: 资产追缴措施旨在有效追回资产并防止非法资金收益
en_quote: These measures ensure effective asset recovery and the prevention of illicit financial gains.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: FATF建议5至8要求按照《恐怖融资公约》将恐怖融资定为刑事犯罪
en_quote: Recommendations 5 to 8 advise jurisdictions to criminalize terrorist financing in line with the Terrorist Financing Convention, ensuring it covers the financing of terrorist acts, organizations, and individuals, even in the absence of a direct link to a specific act.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: 各国应实施定向金融制裁，立即冻结涉恐人员或实体的资产
en_quote: Jurisdictions should also implement targeted financial sanctions in compliance with UN Security Council resolutions; this includes freezing the assets of designated persons or entities without delay to combat the financing of terrorism.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: 各国应实施定向金融制裁以防止和阻断大规模杀伤性武器扩散融资
en_quote: Similarly, jurisdictions should apply targeted financial sanctions to prevent and disrupt the financing of the proliferation of WMDs.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 1-8
knowledge_zh: 识别面临恐怖融资滥用风险的非营利组织并采取风险为本的保护措施
en_quote: Additionally, jurisdictions should identify nonprofit organizations at risk of terrorist financing abuse and implement proportionate, risk-based measures to protect them while ensuring that legitimate activities remain unaffected.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: FATF建议9至23旨在确保成员国有效检测和预防非法金融活动
en_quote: FATF Recommendations 9 to 23 seek to ensure the effectiveness of member jurisdictions' measures to detect and prevent illicit financial activities.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: FATF建议9要求金融机构保密法不得阻碍FATF建议的实施
en_quote: Recommendation 9 advises jurisdictions to ensure that financial institution secrecy laws do not inhibit the implementation of FATF Recommendations.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: FATF建议10和11规定客户尽职调查的触发情形
en_quote: Recommendations 10 and 11 require financial institutions to conduct CDD when initiating business relationships, processing occasional transactions above a set threshold, suspecting money laundering or terrorist financing, or questioning the accuracy of previously obtained customer identification data.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: 金融机构应将交易记录和客户尽职调查信息保存至少五年
en_quote: Financial institutions should also retain transaction records and CDD information for at least five years to ensure timely compliance with requests from relevant authorities.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: FATF建议12至16针对特定客户和活动规定了额外措施
en_quote: Recommendations 12 to 16 provide additional measures for specific customers and activities.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: 金融机构需识别政治敏感人物并验证其财富和资金来源
en_quote: For instance, financial institutions should identify PEPs, obtain senior management approval to establish a business relationship with a PEP, and verify their sources of wealth and funds.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: 金融机构在建立代理行关系前应评估代理行的反洗钱/反恐怖融资管控措施
en_quote: Financial institutions should assess respondent institutions’ AML/CFT controls before initiating a correspondent relationship.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: 货币或价值转移服务提供商须获得许可并接受监管
en_quote: Money or value transfer service providers should be licensed and monitored.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: 金融机构需评估新技术风险并确保电汇中发端人和受益人数据准确
en_quote: Financial institutions should assess risks from new technologies and ensure accurate originator and beneficiary data in wire transfers.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: FATF建议17-19允许金融机构在满足条件时依赖第三方客户尽职调查
en_quote: Recommendations 17 to 19 advise jurisdictions to allow financial institutions to rely on third-party CDD if it meets certain criteria.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: 金融机构应实施反洗钱/反恐怖融资计划并对高风险辖区强化尽职调查
en_quote: Financial institutions should implement AML/CFT programs, facilitate the sharing of information for AML/CFT purposes, and apply enhanced due diligence to business relationships and transactions with persons and institutions from jurisdictions FATF identifies as higher risk.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: 金融机构有义务向金融情报机构报告可疑交易
en_quote: Recommendations 20 to 23 discuss the obligation to report suspicious transactions. Financial institutions should report suspicious transactions to the relevant Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: 法律应保护金融机构及其员工免于责任并禁止披露可疑交易
en_quote: Laws should protect financial institutions and their employees from liability and prohibit them from disclosing suspicious transactions.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 9-23
knowledge_zh: 指定非金融行业和职业需实施内部控制、报告可疑交易并接受监管
en_quote: Designated nonfinancial businesses and professions (DNFBP) should implement internal controls, report suspicious transactions, and be subject to regulatory and supervisory measures to ensure compliance with AML/CFT requirements.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: FATF建议24-40概述加强透明度、机构监督和全球合作的关键措施
en_quote: FATF Recommendations 24 to 40 outline key measures to strengthen transparency, institutional oversight, and global cooperation in AML/CFT efforts.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: FATF建议24和25要求各辖区评估法人和法律安排被滥用的风险
en_quote: Recommendations 24 and 25 advise jurisdictions to assess the risk of misuse of legal persons and legal arrangements.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 各辖区应确保主管机关能获取准确、最新的受益所有人信息
en_quote: Jurisdictions should also ensure competent authorities can access accurate, up-to-date beneficial ownership information on legal persons and trusts, requiring trustees to obtain and maintain such data for transparency and compliance.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 各辖区不应允许法人发行新的不记名股票或不记名认股权证
en_quote: Jurisdictions should not permit legal persons to issue new bearer shares or bearer share warrants and should take measures to prevent the misuse of these types of stocks and documents.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: FATF建议26-35要求各辖区确保金融机构受到适当监管以有效实施FATF建议
en_quote: Recommendations 26 to 35 advise jurisdictions to ensure financial institutions are properly regulated and supervised to implement FATF Recommendations effectively.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 监管机构应具备充分的权力、资源和独立性以监督合规并实施制裁
en_quote: Supervisors should have sufficient authority, resources, and independence to monitor compliance, conduct inspections, and impose sanctions.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 各辖区应对指定非金融行业和职业实施许可、注册和监管
en_quote: Jurisdictions should subject DNFBPs to licensing, registration, and supervision by competent authorities or self-regulatory bodies.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 各辖区应设立金融情报机构以分析可疑交易报告并支持执法调查
en_quote: Jurisdictions should establish an FIU to analyze suspicious transaction reports and support law enforcement investigations.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 主管机关应有权追踪、冻结和扣押犯罪资产并实施跨境货币管制
en_quote: Authorities should have powers to track, freeze, and seize criminal assets, enforce cross-border currency controls, and collect AML/CFT statistics.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 各辖区应制定明确的指引、反馈和相称的制裁以确保合规与执行
en_quote: Jurisdictions should have clear guidelines, feedback, and proportionate sanctions in place to ensure compliance and enforcement.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 各辖区应迅速采纳并全面实施维也纳公约、巴勒莫公约和反恐融资公约
en_quote: Recommendations 36 to 40 advise jurisdictions to swiftly adopt and fully implement the Vienna, Palermo, and Terrorist Financing Conventions, along with other relevant international agreements.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 各辖区应为洗钱和恐怖融资案件提供广泛的司法协助
en_quote: Jurisdictions should provide broad mutual legal assistance for money laundering and terrorist financing cases, ensuring efficient processes for handling such requests.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 各辖区应应外国当局请求迅速采取行动识别、冻结、扣押和没收犯罪资产
en_quote: Jurisdictions should take rapid action to identify, freeze, seize, and confiscate criminal assets at the request of foreign authorities.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: 各辖区应确保对洗钱和恐怖融资进行引渡，包括在无法引渡时起诉本国国民
en_quote: Additionally, they should ensure extradition for money laundering and terrorist financing, including prosecuting nationals if extradition is not possible.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF Recommendations 24-40
knowledge_zh: FATF建议要求当局通过信息交换和联合调查促进国际合作以打击金融犯罪。
en_quote: Authorities should facilitate international cooperation through information exchange and joint investigations to combat financial crimes effectively on a global scale.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: FATF互评估报告关注技术合规性和反洗钱体系有效性两大领域。
en_quote: Mutual evaluation reports of member jurisdictions focus on two areas: technical compliance with the FATF Recommendations and the effectiveness of the jurisdiction's overall program.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: FATF使用11项直接目标（IO）评估有效性，评级分为低、中、显著、高。
en_quote: FATF measures and rates effectiveness using 11 Immediate Outcomes (IOs), with each IO receiving an effectiveness rating of low, moderate, substantial, or high.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: FATF对有效性评级为低或中的司法管辖区提出关键建议并跟踪改进进展。
en_quote: For jurisdictions that FATF rates as having low or moderate effectiveness in IOs, FATF provides key recommended actions and tracks the jurisdiction's progress in meeting the recommendations.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: FATF的直接目标并非检查清单，而是评估人员判断反洗钱/反恐怖融资框架有效性的起点。
en_quote: FATF’s IOs are not meant to be a checklist, but rather a starting point to assist assessors in determining the effectiveness of a jurisdiction's AML/CFT framework. FATF expects assessors to use their judgment and experience in determining their ratings.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 表格列出了11项直接目标的重点领域和具体成果。
en_quote: The table below lists the area of focus and specific outcomes associated with each of the 11 IOs:

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: FATF互评估是成员国之间的同行评审，生成分析反洗钱程序及其有效性的详细报告。
en_quote: FATF mutual evaluations are peer reviews between FATF member jurisdictions that result in thorough reports that analyze AML procedures and their effectiveness.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 典型互评估报告深入描述和分析司法管辖区防止金融系统被犯罪滥用的法律和监管框架。
en_quote: A typical report provides an in-depth description and analysis of a jurisdiction’s legal and regulatory framework for preventing criminal abuse of its financial system.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 互评估报告还包括加强司法管辖区能力的建议。
en_quote: The report also includes recommendations for jurisdictions to strengthen their capabilities.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 互评估要求严格，司法管辖区必须向其他FATF成员证明其合规才能被视为合规。
en_quote: Mutual evaluations are strict, meaning each jurisdiction is only deemed compliant when it can prove the same to other FATF members.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: FATF互评估有两个基本组成部分，主要部分是有效性，通过现场访问收集证据。
en_quote: FATF mutual evaluations have two basic components. The main component is effectiveness and is the focus of an on-site visit to the assessed jurisdiction. During the visit, the assessment team collects evidence demonstrating that the jurisdiction’s measures are operational and deliver the right results.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 互评估的第二部分是技术合规性。
en_quote: The second component is technical compliance.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 被评估成员必须提供其打击洗钱和大规模杀伤性武器扩散的法律法规信息。
en_quote: The assessed member must provide information on its laws and regulations to combat money laundering and the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 技术合规性曾是FATF的主要关注点。
en_quote: The goal of technical compliance has been the main focus of FATF.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 多起洗钱丑闻表明技术合规性不足，FATF重点转向反洗钱有效性。
en_quote: However, numerous money laundering scandals demonstrated that technical compliance was insufficient, and the main focus was shifted to AML effectiveness.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 对FATF互评估的期望因司法管辖区而异，取决于反洗钱及其他金融犯罪风险。
en_quote: Expectations about FATF mutual evaluations differ from jurisdiction to jurisdiction, based on AML and other financial crime risks.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: FATF制定了详细的评估方法以确保评估一致、公平。
en_quote: The organization has developed an elaborate assessment methodology to ensure consistent, fair assessments.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 一次完整的互评估平均需要18个月。
en_quote: A complete mutual evaluation takes an average of 18 months.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 互评估流程包含七个阶段。
en_quote: The mutual evaluation process has seven stages.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 互评估流程的第一个阶段是“开始”。
en_quote: Getting started:

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 评估员培训：为执行评估的专家提供培训
en_quote: Assessor training: Training for the experts who will perform assessment

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 司法管辖区培训：为被评估司法管辖区的代表提供培训
en_quote: Jurisdiction training: Training for representatives of the evaluated jurisdictions

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 评估员遴选：选择组成评估团队的专家
en_quote: Selection of assessors: Selection of the experts that form the assessment team

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 技术审查：评估团队分析司法管辖区的法律法规
en_quote: Technical review: Assessment team analyzes the jurisdiction’s laws and regulations

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 范围界定说明：评估团队确定现场访问的重点领域
en_quote: Scoping note: Assessment team identifies areas of focus for the on-site visit

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 现场访问：评估团队前往司法管辖区审查反洗钱法规的有效性
en_quote: On-site visit: Assessment team travels to the jurisdiction and reviews the effectiveness of AML regulations

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 起草互评估报告：完成互评估报告
en_quote: Draft MER: Finalize mutual evaluation report

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: FATF全体会议通过：互评估报告提交全体会议审议
en_quote: FATF plenary adoption:

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 全体会议讨论：FATF全体会议讨论报告中的发现并对评级进行投票
en_quote: Plenary discussion: FATF plenary discusses the findings in the report and votes on the ratings

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 最终质量审查：所有司法管辖区在报告发布前进行审查
en_quote: Final quality review: All jurisdictions review the report before publishing

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF 11 Immediate Outcomes
knowledge_zh: 发布与后续行动：司法管辖区解决问题并开始加强反洗钱措施
en_quote: Publication and follow-up: Jurisdiction addresses issues and begins strengthening its AML measures

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF high-risk and noncooperative jurisdictions
knowledge_zh: FATF通过全面审查流程识别高风险和不合作司法管辖区
en_quote: FATF identifies high-risk and noncooperative jurisdictions through a comprehensive review process. FATF’s International Cooperation Review Group oversees this process and assesses a jurisdiction's AML/CFT measures to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and risks.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF high-risk and noncooperative jurisdictions
knowledge_zh: FATF因多种原因审查司法管辖区，具体情形包括
en_quote: FATF reviews jurisdictions for many reasons it deems indicative of noncooperation. Specifically, FATF will review a jurisdiction when it:

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF high-risk and noncooperative jurisdictions
knowledge_zh: 不参与区域性反洗钱组织
en_quote: Does not participate in an FSRB.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF high-risk and noncooperative jurisdictions
knowledge_zh: 延迟或不允许区域性反洗钱组织发布互评估结果
en_quote: Delays or does not allow an FSRB to publish mutual evaluation results.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF high-risk and noncooperative jurisdictions
knowledge_zh: 被FATF成员或区域性反洗钱组织提名存在洗钱、恐怖融资或扩散融资风险
en_quote: Is nominated by a FATF member or an FSRB that identifies money laundering, terrorist financing, or proliferation financing risks or threats.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF high-risk and noncooperative jurisdictions
knowledge_zh: 互评估结果不佳，例如
en_quote: Achieves poor results in its mutual evaluation, such as:

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF high-risk and noncooperative jurisdictions
knowledge_zh: 技术合规性方面有20项或更多不合规或部分合规评级
en_quote: Having 20 or more noncompliant or partially compliant ratings for technical compliance.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF high-risk and noncooperative jurisdictions
knowledge_zh: 建议3、5、6、10、11和20中有三项或更多被评为不合规或部分合规
en_quote: Receiving ratings of noncompliant or partially compliant on three or more of Recommendations 3, 5, 6, 10, 11, and 20.

section_title: Financial Action Task Force > FATF high-risk and noncooperative jurisdictions
knowledge_zh: 11项立即成果中有9项或更多有效性评级为低或中等，且至少两项为低

The five domains are:

en_quote: The Tax Justice Network (TJN) is an independent, advocacy-focused organization dedicated to exposing and combating global tax avoidance, evasion, and financial secrecy. Launched in 2003 in the British Houses of Parliament, it researches tax havens, offshore finance, and illicit financial flows. TJN promotes policies for greater transparency and fairer tax systems.

section_title: AFC guidance from other organizations > Tax Justice Network AFC guidance
knowledge_zh: TJN发布金融保密指数、企业避税天堂指数和年度税收正义状况报告。
en_quote: TJN publishes the Financial Secrecy Index, the Corporate Tax Haven Index, and the State of Tax Justice annual report to highlight jurisdictions that enable tax abuse.

section_title: AFC guidance from other organizations > Tax Justice Network AFC guidance
knowledge_zh: TJN的工作影响政策制定者、金融犯罪防控专业人员、记者和活动家。
en_quote: Its work influences policymakers, AFC professionals, journalists, and activists in the fight against global economic inequality.

section_title: AFC guidance from other organizations > Tax Justice Network AFC guidance
knowledge_zh: 金融机构可在基于风险的方法中使用TJN指数评估客户交易。
en_quote: These indices can be part of a financial institution’s risk-based approach to customer transactions.

section_title: AFC guidance from other organizations > Tax Justice Network AFC guidance
knowledge_zh: 金融保密指数根据金融保密程度和跨境金融服务规模对141个司法管辖区排名。
en_quote: The Financial Secrecy Index ranks 141 jurisdictions based on the amount of financial secrecy associated with each jurisdiction. The ranking examines how much financial secrecy a jurisdiction allows and the number of financial services it provides to residents of other jurisdictions. The higher a jurisdiction ranks, the bigger its role in enabling wealthy individuals and criminals to hide and launder money.

section_title: AFC guidance from other organizations > Tax Justice Network AFC guidance
knowledge_zh: 金融保密指数每两年发布一次。
en_quote: The index is published every two years.

section_title: AFC guidance from other organizations > Tax Justice Network AFC guidance
knowledge_zh: 企业避税天堂指数对70个允许跨国公司少缴企业所得税的司法管辖区进行排名。
en_quote: The Corporate Tax Haven Index ranks 70 jurisdictions whose tax policies allow multinational corporations to underpay their corporate income tax. The higher a country ranks, the greater the risk of corporate tax abuse in that jurisdiction.

section_title: AFC guidance from other organizations > Tax Justice Network AFC guidance
knowledge_zh: 税务正义网络报告显示未来十年全球因避税天堂损失4.8万亿美元
en_quote: The State of Tax Justice annual report shares the amount of tax that jurisdictions lose each year related to corporate tax abuse and private tax evasion. According to the 2023 report, jurisdictions will lose US$4.8 trillion to tax havens over the next 10 years.

section_title: AFC guidance from other organizations > Tax Justice Network AFC guidance
knowledge_zh: 可将TJN指数纳入客户风险评估，高指数表明更高风险
en_quote: An organization might incorporate TJN indices to customer risk assessments to assess the risk of a customer engaging in tax evasion or financial crime based on their country of residence or business operations. Higher rankings in these indices indicate jurisdictions with greater financial secrecy or tax haven characteristics, suggesting increased risk levels for customers associated with them.

section_title: AFC Regulations and Regimes > Introduction: AFC regulations and regimes
knowledge_zh: 本模块介绍影响金融犯罪防控专业人员日常工作的监管环境
en_quote: In this module, you will be introduced to the regulatory environment that impacts the daily work of AFC professionals. In addition to learning who some of the major regulators are and what regulatory requirements they impose, you will learn how regulators assess risk, provide guidance, and cooperate with each other and with law enforcement to enforce AML/CFT laws. This material provides the context for understanding how regulatory requirements flow from international guidance to national legislation and finally to operational requirements within covered entities, impacting you as an AFC professional.

en_quote: This module will cover the key global AFC rules and regulations. We will cover the various jurisdictions at a high level. For a detailed overview and analysis, please refer to our AML regulatory framework courses to learn more about the regulatory landscape of a specific jurisdiction.

en_quote: In his proposed policies, he states that continuously reviewing and monitoring relevant guidance, enforcement actions, and proposed policy changes from relevant sources are the keys to success.

section_title: Case example: Drafting policies for an AFC department based in APAC
heading_context: Case example: Drafting policies for an AFC department based in APAC
