section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 《银行保密法》是美国最重要的反洗钱法规
en_quote: The Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) is the US’s most important AML regulation.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 《银行保密法》于1970年实施，旨在打击利用美国银行和金融系统进行的洗钱活动
en_quote: The US implemented it in 1970 in response to criminals using US banks and the financial system for money laundering and other illicit activities.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 《银行保密法》为美国银行和金融机构引入了重要的记录保存和报告义务
en_quote: The BSA introduced significant recordkeeping and reporting obligations for US banks and financial institutions. For instance, the BSA required banks to collect information on customers and their transactions.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 《银行保密法》义务旨在确保执法和监管机构获得调查和起诉所需的金融信息与证据
en_quote: These obligations helped ensure that law enforcement and supervisory agencies received the financial information and evidence they needed for their investigations and prosecutions.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 2001年美国通过《爱国者法案》将《银行保密法》范围扩展至反恐怖融资义务
en_quote: In 2001, the US extended the scope of the BSA to include counter-terrorist financing obligations introduced by the USA PATRIOT Act.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 《银行保密法》引入了多项报告要求
en_quote: The BSA introduced several reporting requirements:

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 货币交易报告
en_quote: Currency transaction reports

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 可疑活动报告
en_quote: Suspicious activity reports

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 持有外国账户的美国公民需提交外国银行账户报告
en_quote: Foreign bank account reports for US citizens holding foreign accounts

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 现金购买货币工具需提交货币与货币工具报告
en_quote: Currency and monetary instrument reports for cash purchases of monetary instruments

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 《银行保密法》要求义务实体基于五大支柱制定、实施和维护有效的反洗钱计划
en_quote: The BSA requires obliged entities to develop, implement, and maintain an effective AML program based on five pillars:

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 制定合理设计的政策、程序和内部控制以确保合规
en_quote: Incorporate policies, procedures, and internal controls reasonably designed to assure compliance with regulatory requirements.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 指定一名反洗钱官负责计划的日常活动
en_quote: Designate an AML officer responsible for the day-to-day activities of the program.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 为员工提供关于其计划职责的教育和培训
en_quote: Provide education and training of employees concerning their responsibilities under the program.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 确保基于风险频率进行独立审计以监控和维护充分计划
en_quote: Ensure independent audit to monitor and maintain an adequate program with a risk-based frequency.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 使用基于风险的方法制定持续的客户尽职调查计划
en_quote: Develop an ongoing CDD program using a risk-based approach.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 《银行保密法》适用于与美国客户交易或使用美国金融体系的非美国银行、货币服务企业和加密货币公司
en_quote: The BSA extends to non-US banks, MSBs, and cryptocurrency firms that deal with US customers or utilize the US financial system.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 外国银行美国分行、与美国客户交易的货币服务企业和加密货币公司须遵守《银行保密法》要求
en_quote: It requires US-based branches of foreign banks to comply with BSA requirements, as well as MSBs or cryptocurrency firms that engage in transactions with US customers.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Bank Secrecy Act
knowledge_zh: 在美国银行持有代理账户的外国金融机构须遵守部分《银行保密法》要求，包括记录保存和应要求提供记录
en_quote: Foreign financial institutions that maintain correspondent bank accounts with US banks are subject to some BSA requirements, including recordkeeping and the obligation to provide records in response to requests from US authorities.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > USA PATRIOT Act
knowledge_zh: 2001年美国颁布《爱国者法案》
en_quote: In 2001, the US enacted the Uniting and Strengthening America by Providing Appropriate Tools Required to Intercept and Obstruct Terrorism Act (USA PATRIOT Act).

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > USA PATRIOT Act
knowledge_zh: 《爱国者法案》引入重大金融犯罪防控义务，强化反洗钱与反恐怖融资措施
en_quote: This Act introduced significant AFC regulatory obligations that have influenced global financial regulations. It strengthened AML/CFT measures, impacting financial institutions worldwide.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > USA PATRIOT Act
knowledge_zh: 《爱国者法案》衍生的关键全球义务列表导引
en_quote: Key global obligations derived from the USA PATRIOT Act include the following topics.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > USA PATRIOT Act
knowledge_zh: 金融机构须验证客户身份、监控交易并评估风险，影响全球反洗钱框架
en_quote: CDD and KYC: Financial institutions must verify customer identities, monitor transactions, and assess risks associated with business relationships. This requirement has influenced global AML frameworks, such as the FATF Recommendations.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > USA PATRIOT Act
knowledge_zh: 美国财政部可指定外国司法管辖区或机构为洗钱风险，迫使银行停止交易
en_quote: Jurisdictions of primary money laundering concern: Under section 311, the US Department of the Treasury can designate foreign jurisdictions, institutions, or transactions as money laundering risks, prompting actions by financial institutions. Designating a jurisdiction or financial organization forces banks to halt financial dealings with the designee.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > USA PATRIOT Act
knowledge_zh: 第313条禁止与空壳银行往来，第312条要求对外国金融机构代理账户实施强化尽职调查
en_quote: EDD for foreign correspondent banking: Section 313 prohibits relationships with shell banks and Section 312 mandates EDD for correspondent accounts held by foreign financial institutions, affecting cross-border banking practices. Section 312 also applies to private banking accounts for non-US persons.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > USA PATRIOT Act
knowledge_zh: 允许美国政府扣押外国银行在美国代理账户中的资金，资金所有者可提出异议
en_quote: Forfeiture from US correspondent account: This Act permits the US government to seize funds from a correspondent account in the US that a foreign bank has opened and maintained. The owner of the funds may contest the seizure.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > USA PATRIOT Act
knowledge_zh: 第314条允许银行与执法机构及国际机构共享信息，并提供安全港保护
en_quote: Information sharing: Section 314 allows banks to cooperate with each other, law enforcement, and international agencies to combat financial crime. It provides institutions with safe harbor liability protections for sharing information.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > USA PATRIOT Act
knowledge_zh: 美国政府可要求外国银行提供代理账户记录，并指定在美国的注册代理人
en_quote: Records relating to correspondent accounts for foreign banks: This Act allows the US government to request the production of various types of records, provides subpoena authority for correspondent accounts of foreign banks, and requires foreign banks to designate a registered agent in the US.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020
knowledge_zh: 2020年《反洗钱法案》旨在现代化美国银行反洗钱合规法规
en_quote: The main focus of the Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020 (known as the AML Act in the US) was to modernize US banking laws and regulations for AML compliance.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020
knowledge_zh: 该法案通过提高透明度和执法措施，扩大反洗钱实践以促进国家安全和情报目标
en_quote: The act also broadens the use of AML practices to further national security and intelligence goals through greater transparency and enforcement measures.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020
knowledge_zh: 创建国家受益所有人数据库，要求实体登记所有权信息
en_quote: This included the creation of a national Beneficial Ownership database, which will be updated with ownership information for entities required to register.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020
knowledge_zh: 预计未来将出台关于数据库访问权限和使用规则的补充规定
en_quote: Additional rules, such as which financial institutions can access the database and how that information may be used, are anticipated in the future.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱合规范围扩大至加密货币及艺术品和古董经销商
en_quote: For example, the act expands AML compliance to include jurisdiction over activities in cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, as well as art and antique dealers.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020
knowledge_zh: 新增针对外国金融机构的调查权，并对隐藏与外国高级政治人物相关交易的行为设定刑事处罚
en_quote: The AML Act also includes new investigative powers regarding foreign financial institutions, while creating new criminal penalties for hiding transactions related to senior foreign political figures.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020
knowledge_zh: 《反洗钱法案》将新金融技术和国家安全优先事项纳入反洗钱合规，是美国银行法的战略更新
en_quote: The AML Act represents a strategic update to US banking law by including new financial technologies as well as national security priorities in AML compliance.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020
knowledge_zh: FinCEN 识别金融犯罪风险并协助资源分配。

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020

The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), Federal Reserve System (FRS), Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), and Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) create a framework that safeguards financial institutions and consumers, mitigating risks that could threaten economic stability. They enforce compliance, promote transparency, and protect investors and depositors, while ensuring trust in financial markets.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020
knowledge_zh: FRS 作为美国中央银行，致力于维护金融体系稳定。
en_quote: The FRS serves as the central bank of the US, working to ensure financial system stability by minimizing and containing systemic risks.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020
knowledge_zh: FRS 开展多种检查以促进金融机构安全稳健及支付结算系统效率。
en_quote: It conducts several types of examinations to promote the safety and soundness of financial institutions while enhancing the efficiency and security of payment and settlement systems.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020

en_quote: Additionally, the FRS provides services to the banking industry and the US government, facilitating US dollar transactions and payments.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020

It fulfills this mission by insuring deposits, supervising financial institutions for safety, soundness, and consumer protection, and ensuring that financial institutions can be restructured or liquidated in an orderly manner if they fail.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020

en_quote: If a financial institution is found in violation of US laws and regulations related to financial crime, these regulators can impose civil monetary penalties, forfeiture of proceeds, limitations on future business activities, and criminal charges against the bank or its officers.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Case study: US regulatory enforcement actions

The foreign bank used the platform to conduct transactions involving parties subject to US sanctions. The Federal Reserve Board concluded that Wells Fargo had insufficient policies and procedures to ensure compliance with US sanctions laws, leading to transactions that violated these regulations.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Case study: US regulatory enforcement actions
heading_context: Case study: US regulatory enforcement actions

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Case study: US regulatory enforcement actions

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Case study: US regulatory enforcement actions
heading_context: Case study: US regulatory enforcement actions

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Case study: US regulatory enforcement actions

en_quote: In September of 2024, the OCC issued an enforcement action against Wells Fargo, identifying deficiencies in the bank's financial crimes risk management and AML controls. The OCC's formal agreement highlighted issues in areas such as suspicious activity reporting, currency transaction reporting, CDD, and customer identification programs. While the OCC did not impose monetary penalties, the agreement required Wells Fargo to obtain OCC approval before expanding into new products or services in areas of moderate or high risk.

knowledge_zh: OFAC制裁项目禁止与列入名单的个人和组织交易，并可能冻结其资产

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Office of Foreign Assets Control
knowledge_zh: 基于管辖权的制裁针对整个司法管辖区，禁止几乎所有类型交易，如对朝鲜、伊朗和古巴的制裁
en_quote: Jurisdiction-based sanctions: These sanctions are brought against entire jurisdictions and prohibit nearly all types of transactions, such as the sanctions against North Korea, Iran, and Cuba.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Office of Foreign Assets Control
knowledge_zh: 基于名单的制裁针对特定实体和个人，包括SDN名单、综合制裁名单和外国制裁逃避者名单
en_quote: List-based sanctions: These sanctions identify and target specific entities and individuals involved in illicit activities or who pose a threat to US national security. section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Office of Foreign Assets Control
knowledge_zh: 次级制裁针对非美国人士与受制裁对手方进行的交易
en_quote: Secondary sanctions: These sanctions are directed at non-US persons for transactions and other specific dealings with counterparties subject to certain OFAC sanctions, such as those with Iranian and Russian SDNs.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Office of Foreign Assets Control
knowledge_zh: 行业制裁针对经济整体部门，如能源、金融或国防，而非特定个人或实体

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Office of Foreign Assets Control

knowledge_zh: 2018年前，成员国对洗钱上游犯罪的定义存在差异。
en_quote: Until 2018, member states differed on the predicate offenses for money laundering.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > History of AML regime in Europe
heading_context: History of AML regime in Europe
knowledge_zh: 欧盟通过2018/1673号指令（反洗钱刑法指令）统一洗钱犯罪定义和处罚最低标准。
en_quote: This led the EU to pass Directive 2018/1673, or the “AML Criminal Law Directive,” which establishes minimum rules concerning the definition of criminal offenses and penalties for money laundering.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > History of AML regime in Europe
heading_context: History of AML regime in Europe
knowledge_zh: 2024年，欧盟修订2018/1673号指令，将违反限制性措施定为刑事犯罪。
en_quote: In 2024, the EU amended Directive 2018/1673 to ensure that violations of EU restrictive measures constitute a criminal offense.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > History of AML regime in Europe
heading_context: History of AML regime in Europe
knowledge_zh: 欧盟推出反洗钱单一规则手册（含第六项反洗钱指令）。
en_quote: The EU also introduced the EU AML Single Rulebook, also known as the EU AML package, which includes the 6AMLD.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > History of AML regime in Europe
heading_context: History of AML regime in Europe
knowledge_zh: 该框架首次结合法规与指令，提高成员国间的协调性和有效性。
en_quote: For the first time, this framework combined a regulation with a directive to increase its level of harmonization and effectiveness within member states.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 2024年欧盟通过反洗钱立法包“单一规则手册”，包含以下内容。
en_quote: In 2024, the EU adopted a package of AML legislation known as the “Single Rulebook.” The package consists of:

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 欧盟第六反洗钱指令（6反洗钱D）
en_quote: Directive (EU) 2024/1640, also called 6AMLD.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 欧盟反洗钱条例（反洗钱R）
en_quote: Regulation (EU) 2024/1624, also called AMLR.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 欧盟反洗钱管理局条例（反洗钱A-R）
en_quote: Regulation (EU) 2024/1620, also called AMLA-R.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 欧盟资金转移条例（FTR）
en_quote: Regulation (EU) 2023/1113, also called FTR.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 6反洗钱D建立在先前反洗钱指令基础上
en_quote: 6AMLD builds on previous AMLDs, such as Directive (EU) 2015/849 (4AMLD).

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 6反洗钱D要求义务实体实施全面的客户尽职调查、维护受益所有人中央登记册并开展风险评估
en_quote: The 6AMLD requires financial institutions and other obligated entities to implement comprehensive CDD procedures, maintain central registers of beneficial ownership information, and conduct risk assessments on state and supranational levels.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 6反洗钱D强化了金融情报机构（FIU）的作用并加强了合作
en_quote: 6AMLD enhances the role of FIUs and strengthens cooperation between national FIUs and other AML authorities.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 欧盟要求成员国将6反洗钱D条款转化为国内法
en_quote: The EU requires its member states to transpose 6AMLD provisions into law.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱R旨在统一各成员国的客户尽职调查和风险评估要求
en_quote: The goal of AMLR is to harmonize CDD and risk assessment requirements across member states.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱R设定现金交易1万欧元限额，并加强政治敏感人物、受益所有人及披露规则
en_quote: This regulation sets a €10,000 limit for cash-based transactions and strengthens rules on PEPs, beneficial ownership, and beneficial owner disclosure obligations for firms in developing nations purchasing high-worth vehicles and real estate assets.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱R要求义务实体评估反洗钱人员的技能、声誉、诚实和正直
en_quote: AMLR requires obliged entities to assess all AML staff for skills, good repute, honesty, and integrity.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱R加强了可疑交易报告（SAR）规则和违规处罚
en_quote: It also strengthens rules on SARs and penalties for violations.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱R将义务实体范围扩展至足球经纪人、职业足球俱乐部和投资移民运营商
en_quote: AMLR expands the perimeter of obliged entities to include soccer agents, professional football clubs, and investment migration operators.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱R中关于足球行业、房地产信息单一接入点和银行账户登记互联的条款稍后生效
en_quote: Provisions relating to the football sector, the creation of a single access point to real estate information, and the interconnection of bank account registers go into effect after the majority of provisions in AMLR.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱A-R设立欧盟反洗钱管理局（反洗钱A），负责直接监督部分金融行业义务实体
en_quote: AMLA-R establishes an EU Anti-Money Laundering Authority (AML Authority, known as AMLA in Europe), which is responsible for the direct supervision of selected obliged entities in the financial sector.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 义务实体根据高剩余风险状况被选为直接监督对象
en_quote: These obliged entities are selected based on the high residual risk profile.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱A-R协调国家主管机构（NCA）的监督并起草二级法规和指南
en_quote: Additionally, AMLA-R coordinates supervision of NCAs and drafts level-2 regulations and guidelines.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱A-R大部分条款于2025年7月生效
en_quote: The majority of AMLA-R went into effect in July 2025.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: FTR落实FATF关于加密资产的建议，禁止匿名加密资产账户和交易
en_quote: FTR implements FATF’s recommendations on cryptoassets and prohibits anonymous cryptoasset accounts and transactions.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: FTR是对资金转移信息条例（EU 2015/847）的重订
en_quote: FTR is a recast of the Regulation (EU) 2015/847 on information accompanying transfers of funds.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package
knowledge_zh: FTR与MiCA于2024年12月生效
en_quote: Together with the Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation (MiCA), FTR went into effect in December 2024.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The role of AML Authority
knowledge_zh: 2021年前欧盟反洗钱制度因成员国执行不一致而碎片化
en_quote: Prior to 2021, the EU’s AML regime was made up of a series of directives that member states were expected to implement. Because the members states did not apply the rules in a coherent manner across the EU, the AML regime faced fragmentation in supervision and enforcement.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The role of AML Authority
knowledge_zh: 欧盟设立反洗钱管理局以确保规则统一实施与协调
en_quote: To mitigate these issues, the EU established a framework whose cornerstone is an EU Anti-Money Laundering Authority (AML Authority). This authority ensures the harmonized implementation of rules and coordination among AML and financial sector supervisors.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The role of AML Authority
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱管理局的职责列表引导句
en_quote: The AML Authority is mandated to:

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The role of AML Authority
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱管理局制定并更新欧盟反洗钱单一规则手册
en_quote: Develop and update the EU’s AML Single Rulebook. This contains a set of rules that harmonize AML requirements applicable in the EU and EEA.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The role of AML Authority
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱管理局直接监管最多40家高风险金融机构
en_quote: Directly supervise up to 40 high-risk financial institutions. The AML Authority ensures the selected entities comply with the Single Rulebook. The AML Authority conducts onsite inspections and imposes corrective measures for remediating deficiencies. Additionally, this authority imposes penalties if appropriate or in all cases involving serious, repeated, or systematic breaches. The AML Authority operates through joint-supervisory teams led by an AML Authority staff member and with participation from NCA personnel.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The role of AML Authority
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱管理局监督国家主管机构确保单一规则手册一致适用
en_quote: Monitor national competent authorities to ensure consistent application of the Single Rulebook. The AML Authority provides guidance, support, and

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The role of AML Authority
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱管理局有权识别并处理系统性监管失败
en_quote: The AML Authority has the authorization to identify and act in cases of systematic failures regarding supervision. Such cases could involve breaches resulting from the improper application of national law transposing EU directives.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The role of AML Authority
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱管理局不同于欧盟FIU，但起支持协调作用
en_quote: Note that the AML Authority is not the EU FIU; rather, it plays a vital role in supporting and coordinating within the FIU's network.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > The role of AML Authority
knowledge_zh: 反洗钱管理局总部设在德国法兰克福，将开始直接监管
en_quote: The AML Authority is expected to commence direct supervision, with its headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: MiCA是欧盟加密资产立法框架，涵盖透明度、披露、授权与监管
en_quote: The Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation (MiCA), also known as MiCAR, has instituted the EU’s legislative framework governing the transparency, disclosure, authorization, and supervision of issuers and virtual asset service providers (VASP) since December 2024.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: 欧盟委员会制定MiCA以应对未监管加密资产对投资者和金融市场的风险
en_quote: The European Commission created MiCA to address the risks that unregulated cryptoassets pose to investors and financial markets.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: MiCA关键条款聚焦于现有金融立法未监管的加密资产
en_quote: Key provisions focus on cryptoassets that existing financial services legislation did not previously regulate.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: MiCA涵盖除电子货币代币和资产参考代币外的加密资产发行与交易
en_quote: For instance, MiCA covers the issuance and trading of cryptoassets other than electronic money tokens (EMT) and asset-referenced tokens (ART).

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: MiCA规定VASP应如何处理加密资产的托管、管理、运营与兑换
en_quote: MiCA provisions set forth how VASPs should handle the custody, administration, operation, and exchange of cryptoassets.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: MiCA监管VASP代表客户接收和执行交易以及提供咨询或投资组合管理
en_quote: For example, MiCA regulates how VASPs receive and execute transactions on behalf of clients and conduct advice or portfolio management.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: MiCA限制EMT仅由已受欧盟金融犯罪防控制度监管的持牌实体发行
en_quote: MiCA restricts the issuance of EMTs to licensed entities such as banks and electronic money institutions that are already subject to the EU’s AFC regime.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: MiCA要求发行ART须获得许可证
en_quote: To issue ARTs, MiCA requires the party to obtain a license.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: 欧盟通常仅向在欧盟设立的实体授予许可证，例外极少
en_quote: Generally, the EU only grants licenses to firms established in the EU because the regulation makes few exceptions.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: 实体须具备声誉良好的股东和董事且无金融犯罪定罪，并拥有有效的金融犯罪防控计划
en_quote: The firm should have qualified shareholders and directors that are of good repute and do not have convictions of financial crime offenses. The firm should also have an effective AFC program.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: 监管机构应拒绝存在严重金融犯罪风险或金融犯罪防控缺陷的牌照申请。
en_quote: If the firm’s business model exposes the firm or the sector to serious financial crime risks or demonstrates deficiencies in the AFC program, the relevant regulatory body should reject the license.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: VASP在受理加密资产上市交易前须评估技术方案、发行人声誉及风险。
en_quote: When receiving a request for admission to trading, VASPs must assess the reliability of the technical solutions, the reputation of the issuer and its development team, and the potential risks linked to the cryptoasset.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: VASP应拒绝上市具有内置匿名功能的加密资产，除非能识别持有人及交易历史。
en_quote: VASPs should reject admission to trading cryptoassets with inbuilt anonymization functions unless they can identify the token holders and their transaction history.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: MiCA制定禁止内幕交易和市场操纵的市场滥用规则。
en_quote: MiCA establishes rules against market abuse, thus prohibiting insider trading and market manipulation.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation
knowledge_zh: VASP须建立市场滥用防控机制并向监管机构报告可疑订单或交易。
en_quote: VASPs must have controls to prevent and detect market abuse and immediately report reasonable suspicions about an order or transaction to the relevant regulatory authority.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: 国际金融机构在各地实施反洗钱计划面临全球政策与当地法规协调的挑战。
en_quote: An international financial institution often experiences complex operating environments. One of the operational challenges is the implementation of its AML program in all its locations. In this context, the interplay between a global, group-wide AML program and the local AML regulations is vital.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: 外国金融机构的美国分行须遵守《银行保密法》的最低标准。
en_quote: For example, the Bank Secrecy Act, which is the primary AML law in the US, requires compliance from US branches of foreign financial institutions. This means foreign financial institutions must ensure that their group-wide policies meet the Bank Secrecy Act’s minimum standards.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: 不同司法管辖区的反洗钱标准存在差异，带来合规挑战。
en_quote: This presents a challenge because AML standards vary across jurisdictions.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: 国际金融机构常为集团反洗钱政策附加特定司法管辖区的附录。
en_quote: To address potential differences in regulations, international financial institutions often attach jurisdiction-specific addenda to their group-wide AML policy.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: 若当地反洗钱标准高于母国，金融机构应在附录中记录更高标准。
en_quote: If a jurisdiction in which a financial institution operates has a higher AML standard than its home jurisdiction, the financial institution should document this in the addendum.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: 香港曾实行10%受益所有人识别规则，高于美国25%标准，国际银行需附加香港附录。
en_quote: For example, from 2012 to 2018, Hong Kong had a more stringent beneficial ownership identification rule of 10%, while the US’s rule was 25%. As a result, all international US banks operating in Hong Kong documented the higher standard in a Hong Kong-specific addendum.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: 国际金融机构内部信息共享是反洗钱任务成功的关键。
en_quote: Information sharing within an international financial institution is another key to the success of its AML mandate.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: 银行保密和数据保护法律可能对信息共享构成挑战。
en_quote: Nevertheless, an international financial institution might encounter challenges pertaining to banking secrecy and data protection laws, such as FATF’s guidance document.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: FATF建议18要求金融机构在允许的情况下对海外分支适用反洗钱原则。
en_quote: FATF’s Recommendation 18 stipulates that where local applicable laws and regulations permit, a financial institution should apply the principles in the Recommendations to its branches and subsidiaries abroad.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: 金融机构应在全球政策与当地附录之间采取平衡方法。
en_quote: The financial institution should have a balanced approach between its global, group-wide policy and its multiple local addenda.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
heading_context: Local AML regulations and crossjurisdictional impact
knowledge_zh: 金融机构应遵守管理监督和治理义务以实现全球政策与当地附录的平衡。
en_quote: To ensure the financial institution achieves this balance, it should abide by its management oversight and governance obligations.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 英国脱欧后反洗钱监管格局变化，仍为FATF成员并实施符合FATF标准的立法。
en_quote: The UK’s AML/CFT regulatory landscape has changed following the UK’s exit from the EU in January 2020. Because it is not part of the EU or the EEA, the UK is not obligated to continue following the EU AMLDs, most recently the 6AMLD. In the current landscape, the UK remains a member of FATF and implements legislation that meets FATF’s AML/CFT global standards. The key legislation includes:

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 英国《2002年犯罪收益法》是反洗钱关键立法之一。
en_quote: Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 英国《2000年反恐怖主义法》是反恐融资关键立法之一。
en_quote: The Terrorism Act 2000.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 英国《2017年洗钱、恐怖融资与资金转移条例》是反洗钱关键立法之一。
en_quote: Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 列举英国负责反洗钱监管的主要机构
en_quote: The following are major authorities in the UK responsible for issuing guidance, investigating money laundering offenses, and enforcing AML regulations.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 英国金融行为监管局（FCA）负责监管金融服务公司的行为
en_quote: The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) regulates and supervises the conduct of financial services firms in the UK. The FCA sets standards, promotes competition, and prevents serious harm to customers within the financial services sector. The body was established in April 2013, taking over from the Financial Services Authority. Its primary focus is on the conduct of all financial firms, ensuring they treat customers fairly and act in a responsible manner.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 英国审慎监管局（PRA）是英格兰银行的一部分，负责审慎监管金融机构
en_quote: The Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) is part of the Bank of England, and it is the prudential regulator of approximately 1,500 banks, building societies, credit unions, insurers, and major investment firms. The body was established in 2013 following a structural change resulting from the Financial Services Act 2012. Its primary focus is on the safety and soundness of financial institutions, particularly banks, insurers, and large investment firms. The PRA works closely with the FCA to ensure a sound financial services environment in the UK.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 英国税务海关总署（HMRC）是洗钱监管机构
en_quote: His Majesty's Revenue and Customs (HMRC) is a supervisory body for money laundering regulations.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: HMRC的目标是与其他执法机构合作打击经济犯罪
en_quote: The HMRC’s objective is to work with other enforcement agencies and government departments to tackle economic crime and help businesses protect themselves from criminal attacks.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 英国金融制裁执行办公室（OFSI）负责实施联合国和欧盟的金融制裁
en_quote: The Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) is part of HM Treasury and is responsible for implementing UN and EU financia sanctions. It was established in March 2016 and works to improve understanding, implementation, and enforcement of financial sanctions in the UK.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > UK AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 英国金融情报机构（UKFIU）接收、分析并分发可疑活动报告（SARs）情报
en_quote: The UKFIU operates independently within the National Economic Crime Command (NECC) as an integral part of the National Crime Agency (NCA). It receives, analyzes, and disseminates intelligence submitted through SARs to share with law enforcement agencies. The NCA has the power of arrest and can seek warrants and court orders. Additionally, it can freeze and confiscate assets it suspects are involved in money laundering, terrorism financing, or other criminal activities.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Australia AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 澳大利亚反洗钱/反恐怖融资立法包括2006年反洗钱/反恐怖融资法案及2024年修正案
en_quote: Legislation includes AML/CTF Act 2006 and AML/CTF Amendment Act 2024.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Australia AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 修正案引入了若干条款
en_quote: The amendments introduce several provisions, including:

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Australia AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 将反洗钱/反恐怖融资义务扩展至指定非金融行业和职业（DNFBPs）
en_quote: Extending AML/CFT obligations to DNFBPs.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Australia AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 授予AUSTRAC更强的执法权力
en_quote: Granting AUSTRAC enhanced enforcement powers.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Australia AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 修改泄密（tipping off）条款
en_quote: Amending tipping off provisions.

section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > Australia AML regulations
knowledge_zh: 强调基于风险的方法（RBA）
