en_quote: Sometimes, different blockchain explorers might present different information on the same transactions due to oversight or misinterpretation.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Attributes of a block and sources of data
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
Attributes of a block and sources of data
knowledge_zh: 用户在使用区块链浏览器前应充分研究其可靠性
en_quote: It is important for users to adequately research their blockchain explorer before using it.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Attributes of a block and sources of data
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
Attributes of a block and sources of data
knowledge_zh: 建议比较不同区块链浏览器的数据以判断可靠性
en_quote: It is also helpful to compare data between blockchain explorers to determine their reliability.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 聚类是加密货币交易中的去匿名化功能
en_quote: An important topic in cryptocurrency transactions is clustering, which is a deanonymizing feature built into some cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 聚类是将多个地址或钱包归为一个钱包以分析交易模式的过程
en_quote: Clustering is the process of using blockchain data to group multiple addresses or wallets into a single wallet in order to better understand transaction patterns on the blockchain.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 多个地址可能属于同一实体，例如同一交易输入中的多个地址
en_quote: For example, because more than one unique address can be used to create a transaction, it is possible that multiple addresses belong to a single entity.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 区块链分析工具通常内置比特币交易的聚类功能
en_quote: Blockchain analytic tools usually have builtin clustering of Bitcoin (BTC) transactions, which allows a better understanding of such activity.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 聚类是比特币等加密货币的去匿名化属性
en_quote: Clustering is an attribute of BTC and several other cryptocurrencies that aid in deanonymizing blockchain transactions.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 同一交易输入中的多个地址很可能由同一实体控制
en_quote: When more than one cryptocurrency address is used in a single transaction input, it is likely that these addresses are controlled by the same entity.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 聚类帮助调查人员分析交易活动并了解全局
en_quote: This information helps investigators analyze activity and better understand the big picture when screening transactions.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 区块链分析工具可视化软件中的聚类功能将地址归入同一钱包以加速分析
en_quote: Most blockchain analytic tools used by investigators have a clustering feature enabled in their visualization software. Instead of showing transactions made by individual addresses, the addresses will be clustered into a single wallet with multiple addresses inside that wallet. By demonstrating which addresses belong to the same entity, it speeds up the task of analyzing and comprehending the data.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 聚类示例的列表引导
en_quote: Example of clustering:

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 地址1和地址2向地址4发送资金
en_quote: Address 1 and address 2 send funds to address 4.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 一段时间后，地址2和地址3向地址5发送资金
en_quote: After some time, address 2 and address 3 send funds to address 5.

section_title: Data as an input for solutions > Clustering
heading_context: Data as an input for solutions
knowledge_zh: 基于共享使用情况对地址进行聚类，将地址1、2、3归为同一实体
en_quote: In this case, it can be assumed with a high degree of certainty that address 1 and address 3 belong to the same entity because address 2 was used with both of these addresses together. In this case, addresses 1, 2, and 3 will be clustered into a wallet belonging to a single entity.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 数据是决策、风险评估、合规和客户参与的关键资产
en_quote: Data is a critical asset for decision-making, risk assessment, regulatory compliance, and customer engagement.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 数据治理为数据管理提供框架、政策和保障措施
en_quote: While data management includes actions taken to store, organize and maintain data, data governance provides the necessary frameworks, policies, and assurance measures to control these processes effectively.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 数据管理与治理委员会专注于准确性、安全性和行业标准合规
en_quote: Committees dedicated to data management and governance across an organization focus on accuracy, security, and compliance with industry standards. These committees are centralized bodies that establish policies, frameworks, and best practices for data handling.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 明确的数据治理标准可确保跨业务单元的一致性，降低错误、金融犯罪或违规风险
en_quote: By setting clear data governance standards, they ensure consistency across business units, reducing the risk of errors, financial crime, or regulatory breaches.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 治理委员会定期接收数据核对、数据血缘及验证测试结果的更新
en_quote: Governance committees receive regular updates on data reconciliation, data lineage, and validation and testing results as part of their oversight responsibilities.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 缺陷在委员会监督下采取纠正措施
en_quote: Deficiencies are subject to corrective actions under the committee’s supervision.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 金融机构必须遵守《通用数据保护条例》、CCPA和巴塞尔III等严格法规
en_quote: Regulatory compliance is a key focus, as financial institutions must adhere to strict guidelines such as the GDPR, the California Consumer Privacy Act, and Basel III.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 委员会监控数据收集、存储和处理是否符合法律和道德标准
en_quote: Committees monitor compliance, ensuring that the organization collects, stores, and processes data according to legal and ethical standards.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 监督有助于减轻法律风险，保护组织免受处罚或声誉损害
en_quote: This oversight helps mitigate legal risks and protects the organization from penalties or reputational damage.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 委员会与IT和网络安全团队合作建立数据保护安全协议
en_quote: Committees work closely with IT and cybersecurity teams to establish security protocols for data protection, preventing breaches, cyber threats, and unauthorized access.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 委员会战略性地监督数据创新，帮助组织获得竞争优势
en_quote: In a more strategic role, they oversee the use of data for innovation. In this role, they help the organization achieve a competitive advantage by identifying valuable trends, improving customer risk assessments, and optimizing detection performance across internal business units.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 数据管理与治理委员会应由对流程和系统结果负责的高管担任主席
en_quote: An executive who is accountable for process and system outcomes should chair data management and governance committees.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 金融犯罪合规委员会主席可由监控或筛查负责人或集团MLRO担任
en_quote: For financial crime compliance committees, the chair may be the head of monitoring or screening. For a senior committee in a large organization, it may be the group MLRO.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance committees
knowledge_zh: 委员会成员应包括最终用户、IT团队和上游数据提供方的代表
en_quote: Committee members should include representatives from the end-user community, IT teams, and the upstream source data providers.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 金融犯罪防控合规技术解决方案依赖数据治理流程确保数据质量
en_quote: AFC compliance technology solutions rely on data governance processes to ensure high-quality data.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 良好的数据治理框架包括持续的审批和监督流程
en_quote: A well-structured data governance framework includes ongoing processes for both approval and oversight.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 数据需要增删、合并、分离等变更以满足合规系统运行需求
en_quote: Data is rarely permanent and will require changes such as additions, deletions, merging, separation, and other transformation activities needed for compliance system operations.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 常见数据变更包括集成第三方观察名单、制裁名单或内部风险数据库
en_quote: Most common changes involve introducing new data sources or modifying existing ones, such as integrating third-party watchlists, sanctions lists, or internal risk databases.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 数据变更需经过正式的变更管理审批流程，包括影响评估、验证、数据映射和治理委员会批准
en_quote: These require a formal change management approval process, which should include impact assessments, validation checks, data mapping, and governance committee approvals before deployment.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 合规系统模型中的阈值、规则或机器学习参数变更需经治理结构批准
en_quote: Changes can also encompass adjustments needed for active operating data used in compliance system models. Governance structures should approve changes to thresholds, rules, or machine learning parameters before implementation.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 并非所有治理流程都涉及变更
en_quote: Not all governance processes involve change.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 监督流程包括定期数据质量评估和关键数据属性审查
en_quote: Oversight processes include periodic data quality assessments and scheduled reviews of key data attributes, such as accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and consistency.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 治理团队通过异常报告、离群值分析和数据对账发现异常并分配纠正措施
en_quote: Governance teams conduct exception reporting, outlier analysis, and data reconciliation exercises to detect anomalies, and assign corrective action for deficiencies under supervision of the committee or delegate.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 纠正措施通常需要额外的治理审批
en_quote: These corrective actions are often associated with data or system changes that require additional governance approvals.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 最佳实践要求在向审计团队和监管机构提交金融犯罪防控合规系统输出前进行结构化审批
en_quote: It is best practice to include a structured approval process before submitting AFC compliance system outputs to other stakeholders, such as audit teams and regulators.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 金融犯罪防控合规系统输出包括可疑活动报告、交易监控输出、数据质量报告和监督结果
en_quote: These outputs include suspicious activity reports, transaction monitoring outputs, data quality reports, and outcomes from oversight processes.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 治理委员会必须审查关键报告的精确性
en_quote: Governance committees must review these key reports for precision.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 基于角色的访问控制根据最终用户角色授权其对特定系统和数据的访问
en_quote: Role-based access control refers to a model of authorizing end-user access to specific systems and data based on the role of the end user.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 数据治理原则要求仅在需要时提供数据访问，并制定明确的政策和程序管理访问权限更新
en_quote: Data governance principles drive organizations to provide users access to data only when needed, with clear policies and procedures in place to govern the update of access rights.

section_title: Governance process > Data governance administration and quality control
heading_context: Data governance administration and quality control
knowledge_zh: 强有力的治理机制增强对数据驱动合规解决方案的信任，确保其有效打击金融犯罪并满足监管期望
en_quote: Strong governance mechanisms generate trust in data-driven compliance solutions, ensuring they remain effective in combating financial crime while meeting evolving regulatory expectations.
